text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp is finally starting...!
On the bus, Symboli Kris S and I were reviewing
the challenges she needed to overcome this summer—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Looks like it's going to be a brutal summer.
choice_data_list: I'm fully prepared on my end.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I promise to get stronger this summer.
...All for the sake of victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leading up to the Tenno Sho (Autumn),
the scorching summer training camp was about to begin—
